title: System主题遇暗色媒体时页面已暗色，theme-color仍为白色
preconditions: Independent fresh browser/profile; real primaryHub8080 authenticated UI
Theme selected by real light/dark/system menu; no configuration/definition changes
steps: Verify explicit light/dark selection and reload: class, cookie and actual meta RGBA match expected palette
Select system while media prefers light and reload
Change media preference to dark: actual root class/body RGB become dark
Reload while media remains dark and inspect meta actual content/RGBA again
expected: System mode dark resolution updates theme-color to dark palette (#020817 / RGBA2,8,23,255), including reload
failure_scope: Only system-media-dark and system-dark-reloaded failed; explicit dark-selected/dark-reloaded and other light/dark persistence/media observations passed.
root_cause: ThemeSwitch derives meta from selected theme (system is treated as light) and effect only depends on theme. ThemeProvider media handler changes root class but does not notify this meta effect; context resolvedTheme is memoized by theme.
